output.summary: A deciduous tree with conflicting native-range accounts in the supplied sources. Its broad leaves are green above and grey-white and downy beneath, while its dull brownish-red fruit ripens in late autumn. The edible fruit was sold at open-air markets in Fontainebleau until the 1950s.
